message: PctWidgetBadge (libs/components/widget/src/badge.ts) takes its template from the decorator
$reason: The template under a name written with a Unicode escape, `t\u0065mplate:`. The parser holds the name's text, `template`, and so does ngc (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker for `check-parts`); a read of the name as written would not.
